ui.description: User interface behavior for PIN and dialog interaction

show_pin_entry.description: Whether to show a GUI PIN entry dialog when needed

pin_entry_timeout.description: Seconds before auto-closing the PIN entry dialog

pin_entry_echo.description: Whether to show characters as typed in the PIN field

storage_dir.description: Directory where certificates and keys are stored

enable_storage.description: Whether to persistently store certificates and keys

secure_erase.description: Whether to securely erase sensitive data on cleanup (e.g., keys)

log_file.description: Path to file for logging output (empty = only stderr/journal)

log_to_journal.description: Whether to send logs to the systemd journal (if available)

auto_trust.description: Automatically trust newly imported CA certificates

default_ca_trust.description: Trust level applied to new CA certs: 'none', 'partial', or 'full'

enabled.description: Enable the GCR daemon for background operations

auto_start_services.description: List of subsystems (e.g., PKCS#11, OpenSSH) to auto-start

max_concurrent.description: Maximum number of concurrent cryptographic operations

enabled.description: Enable forwarding of SSH keys to GCR

socket_path.description: Unix socket path for SSH agent (if enabled; empty = auto-detect)

import_keys.description: Specific SSH key fingerprints to import (empty = import all)
